Hero_Desc_Epica:
A wandering bard werebeast of Elias.
She always recites stories cheerfully and likes extreme situations.
It looks like she found her place within the Order after wandering around in search of new stories and the 'Ultimate Heroine'.
Album_Hate_Epica: Her first stories that, upon retrospect, are just too nooby.
Album_Hobby_Epica: Spacing out all day, thinking up stories.
Album_Wish_Epica: Meeting the perfect protagonist in her own story.
Album_Epica1: Whenever Epica visits the Werebeast Village, they throw a feast. All the little werebeasts gather around, listening to her epic tales of heroes. It inspires them to become heroes themselves. Once, this led to so many "heroic duels" that the village was completely wrecked due to the rampage.
Album_Epica2: Epica visited the Order once and just...never left. Ner wasn't happy about it. She didn't want to house a homeless wanderer. But Epica was so pitiful, sleeping and eating in the garden, that she eventually let her stay in an empty room. When I helped her, she practically worshiped me in gratitude. Honestly... it didn't feel bad.
Album_Epica3: Epica always follows me around in the Order, telling me stories or listening to mine. Thanks to Epica's vast knowledge of Elias' history, myths, and fairy tales, I was able to understand this world much more easily.
Album_Epica4: Since Jade, who manages the Order's archives, loves books, the two of them often spend time together. However, unlike Jade, who prefers to record and preserve information, Epica wants to take those records everywhere and share them, which often leads to arguments between them.
Album_Epica5: One day, I was so hungry that I ended up eating some old baked goods. Epica, who had been secretly watching me, later stood in the town square, singing a story about "The Master Who Devoured the Moldy Bread Golem in One Bite." Setting aside my embarrassment, I started to doubt the credibility of Epica's stories.
Album_Epica6: Epica occasionally rents a theater in the Sprite Kingdom to put on performances. It seems Epica has quite a talent for not only storytelling but also music. I wonder what kind of conversation Epica would have with Festa, Monatium's local busker.
Album_Epica7: When I asked Epica why she was so obsessed with stories, she said it was practice for an audience she would one day meet again. Epica mentioned missing an important performance opportunity long ago and hoped to share her experiences and many tales in front of a warm fireplace when they reunite. Epica had a somewhat sorrowful expression, something rare to see on her usually cheerful face.
Food_ChefNote_Epica_Hate1: Epica complained about it being a bland, romance lacking dish without any heart or stories.
Food_ChefNote_Epica_Hate2: Epica said it was too bland despite getting an intimate and comfortable feeling from it. She wishes there were something more dramatic.
Food_ChefNote_Epica_Like1: Young werebeasts always make sure to bring these when listening to stories. Epica said then they don't disrupt the storyteller that much.
Food_ChefNote_Epica_Like2: Epica praised it as a romantic dish that embodies the fantasy of the story. She almost made a dramatic scene as she tried to gulp it down in one bite.
Food_ChefNote_Epica_Like3: Epica says it's great for snacking on short breaks during long storytelling sessions. Talking can be very energy draining.
Food_ChefNote_Epica_Like4: When Epica asked what kind of food it was, I told a story about Thanksgiving. Her eyes sparkled with interest.
Food_ChefNote_Epica_Like5: Epica found the sour taste quite unfamiliar but dramatically interesting. She packed a few of them to go.
Food_ChefNote_Epica_Like6: Greatly impressed by its unique appearance and backstory, Epica considered using it as inspiration for a story.
Food_ChefNote_Epica_Like7: Epica gladly ate, noting that the food seemed filled with as many stories as the ingredients in it.
Food_ChefNote_Epica_Like8: Epica delighted in saying that sincere food always contains many stories.
Food_ChefNote_Epica_Like9: Epica found it interesting that the taste and color of the candy could tell different stories.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Epica: With our meeting, the curtain has risen on a great epic.
Gacha_Result_Line2_Epica: My tales are told in my own special way
Epica_Growth1: There's always something to learn from every story.
Epica_Growth2: Creation can only come through learning.
Epica_Victory1: After all, isn't a happy ending the best?
Epica_Defeat1: Hah! A hero's tale can't be without trials...
Epica_Defeat2: Sometimes, tragic stories also have meaning.

Epica_Affinity1_2: Saved sprites, subdued werebeasts, converted elves, and ending the dangers...! Praise be to the Master's great deeds!
Epica_Affinity2: Tonight, listen to the tale of an unmatched hero!
Epica_Affinity1_3: I wonder what stories will soon unfold... on the next episode!
Epica_Affinity3: This story is about the Master named Stanley... oops, excuse me. I brought the wrong script.
Epica_Affinity4: Anyone wants an... Encore? Don't people usually want one?

Epica_Affinity7: Oh, Master! The protagonist of my story! What adventure have you embarked on today?
Epica_Die2: It's best to bow out when the time comes.
Epica_LevelUp: It is time to move on to the next chapter.
Epica_Equipment: I wonder what the story is behind this gear...?

Epica_HeroUpgrade: If you want to sing of heroes, you'd better be worthy!
Epica_DeckSetting1: Oh, is there a place for a storyteller?
Epica_DeckSetting2: Ah, great adventures and grand stages!
Epica_Stage: Let it be known, a glorious and magnificent journey has started!
Epica_Touch1_1: Uhh, this makes it difficult to tell my story...

Epica_Touch2: Hum hum, I'll skip this part.
Epica_Touch2_2: It's always nice to feel cared for!

Epica_Equipment_Skin1: A g-gift? Is it a blue one? A borrowed one? A new one?
Epica_HeroSkill_Skin1: I've been practicing a lot, especially singing.
Epica_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: May you and I be on equal footing.
Epica_Touch2_Skin1: It feels as if a path of flowers will open up before my eyes!
Epica_Touch2_1_Skin1: Hehe, are you giving me a hug now?
Epica_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Ow! Mind the horn, you'll hurt your hand on it!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Epica_Skin2: She's always watching! Whether you're eating, taking a nap, or losing money, Epica will stick by your side and cheer you on!
Epica_Growth1_Skin2: Go! Go! You are doing wonderfully!
Epica_Equipment_Skin2: Fancy costumes are a must for cheerleading!
Epica_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: Until the day I become the head cheerleader!

Epica_Touch2_1_Skin2: This is how happiness finds it's way.
Epica_Touch2_2_Skin2: Are you happy too? I'm happy too!
Epica_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Urgh! Was my humble cheering not to your liking?!
Item_HeroSkin_Epica_Skin3: A Story Carried on an Arrowhead
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Epica_Skin3: Once an ordinary citizen, she took up the bow while dreaming of becoming the greatest adventurer. Every arrow she looses strikes true.
Epica_Growth1_Skin3: Hoho, my arrows fly faster than anyone else's!
Epica_Growth2_Skin3: This bow is both my companion and my teacher.
Epica_LevelUp_Skin3: Swift as the wind! Straight as an arrow!
Epica_Equipment_Skin3: Are you not curious how far my arrow can fly?
Epica_HeroSkill_Skin3: I shall show you my skill at shooting with my eyes closed!
Epica_HeroUpgrade_Skin3: A perfect shot every time! Now, if I loose one hundred arrows, I shall land one hundred and one!
Epica_Board_Skin3: I shall advance with the wind.
Epica_Touch1_1_Skin3: Ngh, my arrows have never missed their mark. This is too cruel!
Epica_Touch1_2_Skin3: Now it feels almost like a greeting!
Epica_Touch2_Skin3: Your touch is like a spring breeze.
Epica_Touch2_1_Skin3: Somehow, happiness is welling up within me!
Epica_Touch2_2_Skin3: Ehehe, as peaceful as a forest lullaby!
Epica_DutchRubEnd2_Skin3: I have just chosen my next target in my mind!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Epica_Skin4: The conductor of a grand orchestra that tells stories through magnificent performances. Forming a traveling orchestra has long been Epica's dream.
Epica_Growth1_Skin4: I feel like sounding a fanfare.
Epica_Growth2_Skin4: Performing is delightful, but conducting is delightful as well.
Epica_LevelUp_Skin4: It seems the orchestra has grown larger!
Epica_Equipment_Skin4: An item bearing dignity befitting a conductor!
Epica_HeroSkill_Skin4: I have mastered the art of conducting with my head! My horn is the baton!
Epica_HeroUpgrade_Skin4: A promotion? Is conductor not the highest position?
Epica_Board_Skin4: I must stand where everyone can see me well.
Epica_Touch1_Skin4: If my cheeks grow any larger, I shall not fit upon the podium!
Epica_Touch1_1_Skin4: Art is ever accompanied by pain.
Epica_Touch1_2_Skin4: If you truly must pull, pianissimo, please.
Epica_Touch2_Skin4: Do you perhaps find me admirable?
Epica_Touch2_1_Skin4: Once you finish, please begin again from the start, like a round.
Epica_Touch2_2_Skin4: Your touch flows like a melody~
Epica_DutchRubEnd2_Skin4: Do not strike me! I am no instrument!
Epica_AsideGet: Oh, my! Has the student surpassed the teacher?! Haha! She must have learned a lot from me!
Epica_AsideUpgrade: That's it! That's how you dance with more gusto! How do I teach her to tell stories?
Epica_Ultimate3: I dedicate this to the Master!
Epica_Ultimate3-01: I dedicate this to the Master!
Epica_Anger1: What is the meaning of this!
Epica_Anger5: I can bear this no longer!
Epica_Sorrow2: How could such a thing happen...
Epica_Birthday: Blessings upon today's honored guest! As on every day, but especially so today!
Epica_Gacha2: May I sing of your story?
Epica_Gacha3: Our meeting has raised the curtain on a magnificent epic!
Epica_Line1: At last, I have met you!
Epica_Line2: What story might this place hold?
Epica_Line3: Adventure always sets my heart racing.
Epica_Lobby: Ah, perhaps some fine inspiration will come to me.
LoveLetter_Epica: Master, today I wanted to express my gratitude. You already know that I have traveled far and wide, calling myself a storyteller. I have encountered countless stories and countless protagonists. For the longest time, I believed my role was only to make those protagonists shine. But you were different. You saw me, just a mere storyteller. You allowed me to be part of your story, to write it together with you. Thank you, Master. I will stay by your side until the very last page of your story.
LoveCall_Epica:
Ah, ah. Can you hear me, Master?
The reason I called is that I am planning a new play...
and I would like you to appear in it!
Hmm? You ask what it is about? Hehe, then allow me to tell you a little.

Ahem! Our hero, the Master who protects the peace of Elias!
Even a hero respected by all...
cannot keep weariness from seeping deep into their heart.
To soothe their exhausted body and mind, the Master sets worldly affairs aside and goes for a solitary nighttime stroll.
Then! The Master's steadfast support and longtime friend appears.
Without noticing how late the night has grown, the two clasp hands and talk for hours.
H-Hmm? You ask who will play that friend?
A-Ahem! I could not think of anyone else suited to the role...
so I-I intended to play it myself.

A-Anyway! Explaining any more would spoil the story, so I shall stop here!
Look forward to it. It w-will surely... be a wonderful tale!
Affinity_Epica_EP01_001: People everywhere keep asking me for guidance. What do you think about establishing a school just for storytellers?
Affinity_Epica_EP01_002: A school...? Do you want to bake too?
Affinity_Epica_EP01_003: Hmm... Baking isn't a bad hobby, but what does a school have to do with baked goods?
Affinity_Epica_EP01_004: Sounds good. A bard school is much better than a magic school.
Affinity_Epica_EP01_005: A wizard and a bard are as different as night and day. How can you even compare them?
Affinity_Epica_EP01_007: Indeed! Your wisdom is undeniable, Master. A good storyteller needs more than just eloquence!
Affinity_Epica_EP02_001: Myths are the foundation of all stories. Will you share the myths of your world?
Affinity_Epica_EP02_002: There's one about gods with questionable personalities. It's almost like a sitcom.
Affinity_Epica_EP02_003: Ah, omnipotent yet flawed deities! For some reason, I can't help but feel sympathy.
Affinity_Epica_EP02_004: Was it Ragnarok? Yggdrasil burned when the world ended, right?
Affinity_Epica_EP02_005: Yggdrasil burning at the end of the world?! That's not a story to tell lightly.
Affinity_Epica_EP02_006: What about an eldritch deity that drives you insane just by looking at it?
Affinity_Epica_EP02_007: Fear of the unknown, in its purest form. Not everyone likes cheerful stories, after all.
Affinity_Epica_EP03_001: Master, you are the ultimate protagonist I've been searching for! The perfect lead character for my tales!
Affinity_Epica_EP03_002: You just love the idea of "Master" as a character in your stories.
Affinity_Epica_EP03_003: Nonsense! Even if that were true, you're still the perfect inspiration for a great lead character!
Affinity_Epica_EP03_004: Hehe... It's hard living as the main character in the spotlight.
Affinity_Epica_EP03_005: Hmm... not exactly what I imagined, but they say heroines are usually somewhat eccentric.
Affinity_Epica_EP03_006: Hmm, I've never really done anything grand before. Should I try now?
Affinity_Epica_EP03_007: Such humility and sincerity! I must say, my judgment seems quite reliable.
Affinity_Epica_EP04_001: I love stories... and I also love those who love them in return.
Affinity_Epica_EP04_002: I envy that. Your passion is incredible.
Affinity_Epica_EP04_003: Hah! Life is a journey to ignite the passions we hold. The later it ignites, the fiercer it burns!
Affinity_Epica_EP04_004: I know a phantom who writes cringy, over-the-top fantasy novels. You might change your mind after reading that.
Affinity_Epica_EP04_005: Open your heart! Even a single word from a child can become someone's lifelong motto.
Affinity_Epica_EP04_006: Heh. Want to hear a story?
Affinity_Epica_EP04_007: I can already guess what you're thinking. "I'm going to make sure this story's awful."
Affinity_Epica_EP05_001: The little ones that follow me? They're called Epicons. They are my little friends who help with my performances.
Affinity_Epica_EP05_002: They must come in pretty handy.
Affinity_Epica_EP05_003: Naturally! They cherish my shows more than anyone.
Affinity_Epica_EP05_004: So what exactly are they? Which race do they belong to?
Affinity_Epica_EP05_005: Ahem... I actually wrote a song praising you, Master. Would you like to hear it?
Affinity_Epica_EP05_006: Hmm... They are so cute that I can't focus on the performance.
Affinity_Epica_EP05_007: Master, you must not judge a performance by anything other than the performance itself!
Affinity_Epica_EP06_001: There was a little werebeast who loved reading and requested a play to promote the little red book they adored.
Affinity_Epica_EP06_002: You must be referring to Kommy. You should take whatever she says with a grain of salt.
Affinity_Epica_EP06_003: If I may speak frankly, Master. There are as many perspectives as there are stories.
Affinity_Epica_EP06_004: If you accept every single request, things will get tricky later on.
Affinity_Epica_EP06_005: You are incredibly thoughtful, Master. I only ever saw the bright side. I must reconsider.
Affinity_Epica_EP06_007: Oh, you flatter me too much. Thank you, Master.
Affinity_Epica_EP07_001: I happened to overhear some remarks about me... do I truly come across as that eccentric?
Affinity_Epica_EP07_002: Honestly, it is the way you talk.
Affinity_Epica_EP07_003: T-The way I speak? Wh-What if I spoke like this, M-Master? Umm...
Affinity_Epica_EP07_005: My horn has done nothing wrong! And it is not like I can just take it off!
Affinity_Epica_EP07_006: No, you are totally normal. You're a perfect fit in Elias.
Affinity_Epica_EP07_007: Heh! Since you say so, it must be true. I suppose my worries were needless.
Affinity_Epica_EP08_001: Stories make us yearn for things that do not truly exist... Master, is there such a being for you as well?
Affinity_Epica_EP08_003: W-what nonsense! Unicorns most certainly exist! I am standing right in front of you!
Affinity_Epica_EP08_004: Erpin ruling as Queen without Ner's help.
Affinity_Epica_EP08_005: 'Tis a bit harsh, is it not? Not that I can say anything to the contrary...
Affinity_Epica_EP08_006: Everyone holds a heroine in their heart.
Affinity_Epica_EP08_007: Hah, I like that honesty! That is exactly why I hold you in mine as well!
Affinity_Epica_EP09_001: Ahem! "...And when the mad shadow of candid innocence seeks to cleanse even Elias."
Affinity_Epica_EP09_003: A classic development. But not bad. There is a reason why classics remain timeless.
Affinity_Epica_EP09_004: They will come to know that the chaos that was rejected is in truth a merciful kindness.
Affinity_Epica_EP09_005: Magnificent! A perspective that defies common sense, blurring good and evil into something truly beautiful!
Affinity_Epica_EP09_007: W-What are you doing?! Crafting a story is not child's play!
Affinity_Epica_EP10_001: Master, do you enjoy storytelling? If you were a storyteller, who would you choose as the protagonist?
Affinity_Epica_EP10_002: Obviously me. And for the record, it will be from a first-person perspective.
Affinity_Epica_EP10_003: The one delivering the story, the one narrating it, and the one driving it forward are all you?! Is that not a bit excessive?
Affinity_Epica_EP10_004: That Mayo... I'll let her know why special treatment is a hassle.
Affinity_Epica_EP10_005: Master... Fake obsession can never surpass real obsession...
Affinity_Epica_EP10_006: But...you always talk about other people's stories.
Affinity_Epica_EP10_007: M-me, as the protagonist?! If that is what you want, I will gladly accept it! I do not know the reason, but...thank you.
Affinity_Epica_EP11_001: The Banquet Hall always has a pleasant atmosphere. Have you considered installing a stage?
Affinity_Epica_EP11_002: The seventies and eighties? The eighties and nineties? Are we opening a retro live cafe?
Affinity_Epica_EP11_003: What meaning do those numbers hold? How profound.
Affinity_Epica_EP11_004: Is every place with you not already a stage?
Affinity_Epica_EP11_005: Ah~ Haha! Indeed, indeed! Wherever I go can become a stage for a performance!
Affinity_Epica_EP11_006: A whining Fairy, a singing Beastfolk, haaah~
Affinity_Epica_EP11_007: Y-You need not embarrass me so thoroughly... I only asked once...
Affinity_Epica_EP12_001: Sing~ Sing~ How long will you keep my shoulders dancing?
Affinity_Epica_EP12_002: I sing the newest popular song I remember.
Affinity_Epica_EP12_003: Oh, what a fascinating song! I have never heard it before. Will you teach it to me properly someday?!
Affinity_Epica_EP12_004: I sing a foreign song whose words no one understands.
Affinity_Epica_EP12_005: Are those truly the correct lyrics? I cannot understand a word!
Affinity_Epica_EP12_006: I splash cold water on her to calm her down.
Affinity_Epica_EP12_007: Ugh... Ughh... If you did not want to sing, you could simply have said so...
Affinity_Epica_EP13_001: Master, do you have an entertaining story? I am bored, so tell me one.
Affinity_Epica_EP13_003: Hmm? Why has your gaze suddenly turned cold? I only asked a question.
Affinity_Epica_EP13_004: Would you not be the one with stories to tell?
Affinity_Epica_EP13_005: Ah~ Of course I have stories! I shall begin one at once! Once upon a time~
Affinity_Epica_EP13_006: Oh, the endless tale of you and me...
Affinity_Epica_EP13_007: ...It is a gift we exchange without end! Every day shall be our anniversary!
Affinity_Epica_EP14_001: How strange. One of the Epicons that follows me seems to have disappeared.
Affinity_Epica_EP14_002: Do they not simply emerge endlessly from somewhere?
Affinity_Epica_EP14_003: Endlessly?! Are you not being far too careless? Epicons are not expendable items!
Affinity_Epica_EP14_004: I saw one wandering outside the Banquet Hall. How many are there in total?
Affinity_Epica_EP14_005: Hmm, was it forty-two...? Is that not a fundamental number?
Affinity_Epica_EP14_006: I picked one up and sold it secondhand.
Affinity_Epica_EP14_007: You bought and sold an Epicon?! For how much... No, do not do such a thing! Where did you sell it?!
Affinity_Epica_EP15_001: Do you also think my attitude and manner of speaking are somewhat overwhelming, Master?
Affinity_Epica_EP15_002: No, not at all. I like them very much.
Affinity_Epica_EP15_003: Truly? Thank you. Receiving your reassurance puts my mind at ease, Master!
Affinity_Epica_EP15_004: There are occasions when they can be, depending on the situation.
Affinity_Epica_EP15_005: Is that so? I shall watch the mood and judge when it is proper to step forward.
Affinity_Epica_EP15_006: You have been showing off far too much.
Affinity_Epica_EP15_007: Whinny! What sort of gaze have you been viewing me with all this time?! How cruel!
Affinity_Epica_EP16_001: Hmm... Have my horns become too sharp? Are they dangerous? Should I file down the tips?
Affinity_Epica_EP16_002: Wait! Wait! I will file them! I have always wanted to try it!!!
Affinity_Epica_EP16_003: W-Will you? Then gently rub them with this sandpaper.
Affinity_Epica_EP16_004: It looks as though they would snap if I gripped them and applied a little force.
Affinity_Epica_EP16_005: Wh-What are you trying to do?! My magnificent horns are my pride~!
Affinity_Epica_EP16_006: Leave them alone. You may need them as emergency weapons.
Affinity_Epica_EP16_007: Well... If that is what you think, Master... I shall leave them for now.
Affinity_Epica_EP17_001: I suspect many secret tales lie hidden beneath the Order. Please let me enter just once!
Affinity_Epica_EP17_002: I will let you enter briefly tomorrow afternoon.
Affinity_Epica_EP17_003: Truly? I shall never forget this kindness!
Affinity_Epica_EP17_004: Absolutely not! Ner would scold me!
Affinity_Epica_EP17_005: As I suspected. It cannot be helped. I heard there is a phantom who knows a secret route inside...
Affinity_Epica_EP17_006: Hmm~ You cannot expect it for nothing, can you?
Affinity_Epica_EP17_007: You demand payment?! The Master is buying and selling access to the basement! I shall report this to the High Priest!
Affinity_Epica_EP18_001: I watched something called a film from your homeland at the Elven theater, Master! It was delightful!
Affinity_Epica_EP18_002: There are many masterpieces. Which film did you watch? What was its title?
Affinity_Epica_EP18_003: Hmm... The film with the white wizard stayed in my memory! I want to become like that too!
Affinity_Epica_EP18_004: I have the strange feeling those films keep becoming more recent.
Affinity_Epica_EP18_005: What do you consider the boundary of a recent film? This is a subject I do not understand well.
Affinity_Epica_EP18_006: Shall we watch a horror film sometime?
Affinity_Epica_EP18_007: How can anyone watch such a thing? Even the posters frighten me terribly!
Affinity_Epica_EP19_001: I have been practicing impressions lately! They will make my stories even more entertaining!
Affinity_Epica_EP19_002: Try one! I want to hear it too!
Affinity_Epica_EP19_003: Waaah! Hmph! Master! Hand over the cake for today's ninth snack time!!
Affinity_Epica_EP19_004: Could the person you imitate not find it upsetting?
Affinity_Epica_EP19_005: Could the person you imitate not find it upsetting?
Affinity_Epica_EP19_006: Good, good! I am a brilliant storyteller~!
Affinity_Epica_EP19_007: Ugh... I do not speak that way! I am much gentler and more humble~!
Affinity_Epica_EP20_001: If I charged admission for my stories, what price would be appropriate...?
Affinity_Epica_EP20_002: Are you short of money lately? Why charge a fee all of a sudden?
Affinity_Epica_EP20_003: Some people have demanded that I pay for the space when I tell stories... It concerns me.
Affinity_Epica_EP20_004: Who would watch if you charged money? I will not watch anymore!
Affinity_Epica_EP20_005: Whinny?! I-I will not charge anything! Simply come and see me~!
Affinity_Epica_EP20_006: A price that you consider fair should be fine.
Affinity_Epica_EP20_007: I-Is that so? Hmm... Would one hundred Crystal Leaves be reasonable?
